scope: Development photographs; automatically prompted pretrained segmentation, no annotation, supplied corners, ROI, retraining or templates. Frozen RGB material estimates are unchanged. Pretraining overlap with these public photographs is unknown.
timingScope: CPU float32 with two intra-op threads. Encoding includes SAM preprocessing; decode includes full-source upsampling and 256-field sampling. Frozen proposal-CNN inference, imports and model startup excluded from per-photo inference figures. Not browser timings.

notes: All 22 positive prompts lie on the photographed heart in visual review. Some boxes include handles, hands and props.
Box-only single-mask prediction selects background on several photographs; adding the interior point corrects many of these failures.
The box-plus-point mask sometimes separates only one paper, most visibly on blue/yellow checker and hand-held printed checker. Two previously proposed crops are lost.
SAM can still retain nearby decorations or the handle.
Eight point-plus-box cases remain without a crop. The rotated green/gold star, rabbit and floral/striped photo have very high known-region body overlap but still fail locator checks.
All fourteen proposed physical outlines have partial known-region IoU at least .968. This supports reviewing their templates, but does not establish accurate hidden overlap corners.

pipelinePlan.selectionScope: Development choice after all 66 crop outputs were inspected. Nine box-only proposals are a subset of the fourteen point-plus-box proposals. No per-photo method selection.
pipelinePlan.sourceArtworkAccuracy: Separate partial-label check; derived-mask agreement is not ground truth.

limitations: Repeatedly inspected development photos, not untouched evaluation. Pretrained SAM overlap with these public photos is unknown.
Body scores use partial labels, excluding uncertain pixels. Crop counts are not reconstruction successes.
No per-photo best-arm selection, thresholds unchanged. Production fallback is not included in these proposal counts.

pipeline.derivedMaskScope: Development replay after inspecting all crop proposals. Compare production, unchanged neural body plus RGB materials, and SAM box-plus-point body with the same materials. Neural crop geometry is frozen from the completed 66-case replay; production runs fresh. All 22 sources, no exclusions or per-photo method choices. Ten-second fitting budget. Derived-mask checks are not known-artwork recovery. SAM timing excludes prior proposal-model inference and startup. No training or deployment
visualFindings: Yellow/teal checker, boar, hand-held red/green checker and crayon-coloured checker now produce usable-looking reconstructions after prior crop/classification failures.
The printed-heart checker remains incorrect as a paper-identity reconstruction: both approaches try to weave the printed hearts. It fails the SAM feature check despite only 1.94% overall mask error.
Several checked outputs retain small bumps, gaps or border artifacts; a checked mask fit is not a claim of exact motif recovery.
The aircraft proposal concerns only the overlap square; it does not recover protruding paper outside that square.
The bicycle remains failed in both methods; its verified reference construction requires enclosed cutouts.

sourcePaperDiagnostic.scope: Post-hoc diagnostic on six photos with pre-existing approximate overlap references. Score the SAME known source-paper cell centres inside an inset [0.1,0.9] reference square in every arm; never choose evaluation positions from the predicted crop. One phase chosen from classified observations and retained for exported weave. No references enter reconstruction.
limitations: Approximate reference corners, partial interior labels and nearest-neighbour sampling; neither full motif boundary accuracy nor cutting-path ground truth.
Sixteen of the twenty-two photos lack independently supplied overlap references in this diagnostic; they remain unscored.
Unknown paper pixels and the outer ten percent of the reference square are not evaluated.
No crop/output is reported as unavailable, not assigned a misleading low error.

failureTrace.scope: Post-hoc debug trace of eight failed single-point crops; closest means minimum sum of gate violations, not a new selection policy. Same fields and thresholds.
findings: The rotated green/gold star DOES reach an upright fit at 268.12 degrees. Its lower-edge supports exceed .95 and both cap-colour losses are low, but one lobe support is .611, below .65. Its failure is not simply missing rotation search.
Rabbit likewise has strong lower edges and low cap-colour loss, but its fitted left lobe support is .472. Accurate silhouette prediction alone has not fixed the shape fit.
Floral/striped has adequate lobe and lower-edge support but cap-colour loss .394 exceeds .30. The two-flat-paper colour assumption fails on this printed paper.
Other failures combine leaked foreground, incomplete paper segmentation and poor fitted outlines. Support thresholds were not weakened.
